items.title: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient
items.snippet: AI coding agents can waste time and tokens relearning the same lessons. TokenEconomizer is an open-source plugin that builds on past sessions to cut costs while maintaining task success. It’s a path toward coding agents that learn not only how to solve tasks, but also how to spend computation more effectively. The post TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.title_ar: TokenEconomizer: plugin مفتوح المصدر يخفض تكلفة coding agents
items.summary_ar: أطلق فريق Microsoft Research TokenEconomizer، وهو plugin مفتوح المصدر يبني على الجلسات السابقة لتقليل إعادة تعلم الدروس نفسها في AI coding agents. يهدف إلى خفض تكلفة الـ tokens مع الحفاظ على نسبة نجاح المهام.
items.why_ar: يمكنك تجربته خلال أيام على agents البرمجة الداخلية لخفض تكلفة الـ tokens وتحسين الـ latency.
items.title_en: TokenEconomizer: open-source plugin to cut coding agent costs
items.summary_en: Microsoft Research introduced TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that builds on past sessions so AI coding agents stop relearning the same lessons. It aims to cut token costs while maintaining task success.
items.why_en: You can try it within days on internal coding agents to reduce token spend while keeping task success rates.

items.title: llm 0.37.3
items.snippet: Release: llm 0.37.3 A bug fix release for LLM , mainly to cover a problem with the most recent Homebrew package of the software. Homebrew now ships the latest SQLite, 3.54.1 , which includes a fix that broke LLM's logging code . items.title: Sage S2.1 Flash Technical Report
items.snippet: We introduce Sage S1.5 Flash, a 320-billion-parameter general-purpose mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments. Sage Sci-Perception uses dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences and represents spectra as ordered patches of measurements. Modality-specific projectors map these representations into the input space of a shared backbone, which processes them alongside text and images. To develop the model's agent capabilities, we construct verifiable environments for tool use, search, and coding, as well as specialized workflows involving machine learning experiments and scientific software. items.title_ar: تقرير Sage Flash: موديل mixture-of-experts للاستدلال العلمي والوكلاء
items.summary_ar: يقدم التقرير موديلاً بحجم 320 مليار parameters بمعمارية mixture-of-experts مصمماً للاستدلال على الأدلة العلمية والتفاعل مع بيئات تفاعلية. يستخدم encoders مخصصة لـ molecular graphs والتسلسلات البيولوجية، ويعالج الأطياف كـ patches مرتبة، ثم يدمج كل ذلك مع text وimages في backbone مشترك. ولتطوير قدرات agent بُنيت بيئات قابلة للتحقق لاستخدام الأدوات والبحث والـ coding. ملاحظة: النص يذكر S1.5 بينما العنوان يذكر S2.1.

items.title_en: Sage Flash Report: mixture-of-experts Model for Scientific Reasoning and Agents
items.summary_en: The report introduces a 320-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model designed to reason over scientific evidence and act in interactive environments. It uses dedicated encoders for molecular graphs and biological sequences, represents spectra as ordered patches, and projects all modalities into a shared backbone alongside text and images. Agent capabilities were developed using verifiable environments for tool use, search, and coding. Note: the text refers to S1.5 while the title says S2.1.
items.why_en: It is a multimodal agent model evaluated on tool use and coding, which matters for building agent-based solutions.

items.title: SWE-CoWork: Benchmarking Coding Agents as Digital Employees in Organizations
items.snippet: A coding agent working within a software organization must establish what to build, collaborate with colleagues, and verify what it delivers. We introduce SWE-CoWork, a benchmark comprising 101 development assignments across 101 real repositories, 11 programming languages, and 12 application domains. Each assignment places an agent in a simulated engineering organization with 26 colleagues who have distinct responsibilities, bounded knowledge, and controlled collaboration behavior. Starting from a brief handoff, agents must recover requirements distributed across colleagues and workplace records, reconcile conflicting evidence, and implement changes evaluated by private executable tests. We
items.title_ar: SWE-CoWork: benchmark لتقييم coding agents كموظفين رقميين
items.summary_ar: يقدم البحث SWE-CoWork، وهو benchmark يضم 101 مهمة تطوير عبر 101 repositories حقيقية و11 لغة برمجة. يضع كل مهمة الـ agent داخل مؤسسة هندسية محاكاة فيها 26 زميلاً لهم معرفة محدودة وسلوك تعاون متحكم فيه. يجب على الـ agent استخراج المتطلبات وتوفيقها وتنفيذ التغييرات، ويُقيَّم بـ private executable tests.
items.why_ar: يفيدك لتقييم agents البرمجية في سياق مؤسسي قريب من بيئة البنك، وتصميم tests للـ agents الداخلية.
items.title_en: SWE-CoWork: Benchmarking Coding Agents as Digital Employees
items.summary_en: The paper introduces SWE-CoWork, a benchmark of 101 development assignments across 101 real repositories, 11 programming languages, and 12 application domains. Each agent operates in a simulated engineering organization with 26 colleagues holding distinct knowledge. Agents must recover requirements, reconcile conflicting evidence, and implement changes judged by private executable tests.
items.why_en: It is a relevant evaluation framework for designing and testing coding agents in an enterprise-like setting.

items.title: Centered Ablation: Why Last-Layer Directional Ablation Under-Fires or Collapses, and a Closed-Form Fix
items.snippet: Directional ablation removes a hidden state's component along a "behaviour direction" while a language model runs. It is the standard way to switch a behaviour such as refusal off, but it is erratic: on some models it barely fires, on others the text collapses into repetition. We show why, and fix it. At the last residual stream, ablation is exactly a logit bias: a fixed vocabulary footprint scaled by a gate, the cosine between the hidden state and the direction. The gate is measured from the origin, but last-layer states share a large common mode far from it, so a direction that overlaps the common mode fires on benign text and under-fires on its targets. Centered Ablation (CA) projects the
items.title_ar: Centered Ablation: إصلاح directional ablation في الـ LLMs
items.summary_ar: يشرح البحث سبب عدم استقرار directional ablation المستخدم لإيقاف سلوك مثل الرفض، إذ يفشل أحياناً أو ينهار النص إلى تكرار. يبيّن أن التثبيت على الطبقة الأخيرة يعادل logit bias، وأن الـ common mode في الحالات الخلفية يفسد قياس البوابة. يقترح Centered Ablation بحل closed-form يعالج هذه المشكلة.
items.why_ar: يفيدك في فهم وضبط سلوك LLM الداخلي، وهو مهم للـ safety والـ guardrails في تطبيقات البنك.
items.title_en: Centered Ablation: Fixing Last-Layer Directional Ablation in LLMs
items.summary_en: Directional ablation is a standard way to switch off behaviors like refusal, but it is erratic across models. The authors show that last-layer ablation acts as a logit bias whose gate is distorted by a shared common mode. Centered Ablation projects out this common mode and offers a closed-form fix.
items.why_en: It offers practical insight into controlling LLM behavior, relevant to safety and guardrail design.

items.title: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation and Commitment Coordination
items.snippet: In many long-horizon settings, an agent's own choices create future constraints: committing finite capacity establishes future obligations and forecloses later opportunities. Sustaining performance therefore requires both keeping evolving plans feasible and comparing the value of resource allocations with the alternatives they displace. Recent benchmarks increasingly evaluate LLM agents in continuing operations, but give less attention to how agents keep their own commitments feasible while reassessing resource allocations as opportunities change. items.title_ar: OutfitterBench: benchmark لتقييم LLM agents في تخصيص الموارد على المدى الطويل
items.summary_ar: يقدم الباحثون OutfitterBench وهو benchmark يختبر agents لمدة 200 يوم في إدارة نشاط تأجير معدات مع شراء من كتالوج يضم 46 منتجاً. يقيس التقييم قدرة الagent على إبقاء التزاماته قابلة للتنفيذ وإعادة تقييم تخصيص الموارد عند تغير الفرص.
items.why_ar: يفيدك في تصميم تقييم agents لعمليات طويلة المدى تخلق فيها القرارات التزامات مستقبلية، وهي حالة قريبة من العمليات المصرفية.
items.title_en: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation
items.summary_en: The authors introduce OutfitterBench, a benchmark where agents run an outdoor-equipment rental business for 200 days, purchasing from a 46-product catalog. It measures whether agents keep their commitments feasible while reassessing resource allocation as opportunities change.
items.why_en: It is directly useful for designing evaluations of long-horizon agents where current decisions create future obligations, similar to banking operations.
